research_mode: official Home Office sources only; police-recorded-crime open-data schema, outcome data-flow, technical definitions and special-collection linkage gates; no parcel result or safety score claimed

sources.name: Outcomes framework police discretion purpose
verified_claims: the framework was designed to recognise the full range of disposals and avoid favouring one outcome
officers were intended to use professional judgement to select an appropriate disposal
limitations: no outcome category should be ranked automatically as universally better

sources.name: Outcomes framework victim orientation
verified_claims: the framework aimed to remove perverse incentives from detection targets and encourage consideration of victim needs
limitations: the stated policy purpose is not a measured victim-service result

sources.name: Outcomes framework transparency purpose
verified_claims: assigning every crime an outcome was intended to provide a richer picture and support public accountability
limitations: transparency does not make outcome distributions directly comparable across offences or forces

sources.name: Alternative charge or caution possibility
verified_claims: a suspect can be charged or cautioned for an offence different from the offence originally recorded
limitations: the recorded offence and disposal offence must not be assumed identical

sources.name: Alternative-offence outcome transition
verified_claims: outcomes 1A, 2A and 3A were introduced voluntarily in April 2016 and became mandatory in April 2017
limitations: coverage before mandatory implementation may be incomplete

sources.name: Outcome 1 charge or summons definition
verified_claims: Outcome 1 records that a person was charged or summonsed irrespective of any subsequent acquittal
limitations: Outcome 1 is not a conviction measure

sources.name: Outcome 4 taken-into-consideration definition
verified_claims: Outcome 4 requires a formal interview admission and corroborating verifiable auditable information connecting the suspect to the crime
limitations: an informal admission alone does not meet the published definition

sources.name: Outcome 5 offender-died definition
verified_claims: Outcome 5 applies when the offender died before proceedings could be initiated
limitations: the outcome does not describe evidential strength

sources.name: Outcome 6 penalty-notice definition
verified_claims: Outcome 6 records a lawfully issued Penalty Notice for Disorder or other relevant notifiable offence under the specified legislation
limitations: a penalty notice is distinct from charge, caution and conviction

sources.name: Outcome 7 cannabis or khat warning
verified_claims: Outcome 7 records a cannabis or khat warning issued under College of Policing guidance
khat warnings were introduced on 24 June 2014 and numbers are expected to be small
limitations: the outcome is offence-specific and historically limited

sources.name: Outcome 8 community-resolution definition
verified_claims: Outcome 8 records a Community Resolution with or without formal restorative justice
limitations: community resolution is an informal out-of-court outcome

sources.name: Outcome 9 CPS public-interest decision
verified_claims: Outcome 9 applies when the Crown Prosecution Service decides prosecution or other formal action is not in the public interest
limitations: the outcome is a public-interest decision and not a finding that no crime occurred

sources.name: Outcome 10 police public-interest decision
verified_claims: Outcome 10 applies when police decide formal action against the offender is not in the public interest

sources.name: Outcome 11 below-age-of-responsibility definition
verified_claims: Outcome 11 applies where a named suspect is below the age of criminal responsibility
limitations: the outcome is a prosecution bar and not an absence-of-suspect category

sources.name: Outcome 12 suspect-too-ill definition
verified_claims: Outcome 12 applies where a named suspect is too physically or mentally ill to prosecute
limitations: the outcome does not imply the allegation was disproved
